open_points.subject: Project-overview partial-failure classification
open_points.text: “the project overview answers a failed part as `temporarily_unavailable` with no value” does not define which declared failures count as failure of a part rather than failure of the whole operation, while the same convention maps “Registry 502, persistence and storage 500”
open_points.question: Which failures during each overview component must be converted to `temporarily_unavailable`, and which must still propagate through `error_policy` and fail the whole request?
options: Only the explicitly described post-guard Registry context failure is converted
Any declared dependency failure local to a component, including persistence failures, is converted
A closed subset of Registry and persistence failures is converted; all others propagate
open_points.default_guess: Convert declared post-authorization dependency failures that can be attributed to one component, including its persistence read, while propagating authorization, request-validation, cancellation and unexpected implementation failures.

witness.initial: A staff member is authorized to read an active project; its budget and photos are readable, but the expense repository raises a persistence failure while building the overview.
events: The staff member requests the project overview.
The authorization guard succeeds, including Registry lifecycle validation.
derived_views builds the budget successfully and then encounters the persistence failure while reading expenses.
outcomes: The route returns a successful ProjectOverview with expenses marked `temporarily_unavailable`, while the readable components remain available, because the failure belongs to one part.
The persistence failure follows the stated persistence mapping and the whole route returns 500, because the texts never classify persistence failure as a part-local failure.
